# Waypost agent documentation

M0: foundation only. Generated tool pages expose native navigation and a
#result-data JSON element. Tools that have not shipped say Coming soon.
The exact target behavior is documented in HANDOVER.md sections 4, 7 and 10.
Current shipped behavior and deployment status are in PROGRESS.md.

Deployment root: URL of config.js. Never assume the app is hosted at /.
Demo mode: automatically selected on *.github.io. Sync and AI are off.
Workspace JSON Schema: schemas/workspace.json.
